description:
Writing marvellous stories for young kids about the Mars rovers Opportunity (Oppy) and Spirit. We hope our story inspires youngsters to love space adventures and one day join us here.

Team: Yizen (12) - NASA app fan, dreams of joining NASA. Deshawn (11) - loves rover models, dreams of visiting NASA. Kayra (11) - space fact reader since age 3, future astronomer.
